title: SPRINGS OF EARTH — Every spring pinned to a real place on Earth. North America. GPS coordinates. Gaia and Cursor decided together.
kevin_declaration: We know hotSpring is Yellowstone. ludoSpring is MSU campus. Now pick ALL the other springs and assign them spots on planet Earth in North America. Trace, backtrack, scatter, expand the GPS world.

origin.name: MSU — Michigan State University
origin.what: The origin (0,0). Where Kevin sits. Where northGate lives. Where the organism was born.
origin.why_here: This is HOME. You open your eyes from the dive and you're in the backyard on campus. Imagination starts here.

springs.name: ludoSpring
springs.location: MSU Campus — Demonstration Hall / IM Sports Circle
springs.why_here: ludoSpring IS the campus playground. Fitts, Hick, Flow — these are EXERCISE SCIENCE. The coliseum of game science is right here at the intramural fields where bodies play. 982 tests = 982 reps.

springs.name: hotSpring
springs.location: Yellowstone National Park — Grand Prismatic Spring
springs.why_here: Grand Prismatic IS hotSpring. Bands of color = bands of temperature = bands of life. Thermus aquaticus found here (Brock, 1966). Taq polymerase = PCR = the foundation of all molecular biology. hotSpring does computational physics. The spring does ACTUAL physics. Same thing.
springs.feature: Grand Prismatic Spring — 370ft diameter, 160°F, bands of thermophilic archaea

springs.name: wetSpring
springs.why_here: The Everglades IS metagenomics. A river of grass. Invisible diversity beneath the surface. More species per cubic meter than almost anywhere on Earth. wetSpring does bioinformatics — the genome of the water. The Everglades IS the genome of the water.
springs.feature: River of grass — 60 miles wide, 6 inches deep, 100 miles long

springs.name: primalSpring
springs.why_here: primalSpring validates everything. It's the peer reviewer. U of M is Michigan's other great university — the RIVAL. Peer review requires an independent institution. 70 miles from MSU. Close enough to visit, far enough to be independent. The forge where primals are tested.

springs.name: groundSpring
springs.why_here: Montana IS the ground. Bedrock. The mountains are the oldest exposed rock in North America. groundSpring is soil science, the foundation. Montana's Bitterroot is where Lewis & Clark first touched the ground that became the western US. The foundation of the continent.
springs.feature: Bitterroot Mountains — Precambrian Belt Supergroup, 1.5 billion years old

springs.name: airSpring
springs.location: Albuquerque, New Mexico — Sandia Peak / Balloon Fiesta Park
springs.why_here: Albuquerque hosts the International Balloon Fiesta — 500+ hot air balloons every October. The air IS the event. Sandia Peak at 10,678 ft has some of the clearest air on the continent. airSpring is about atmosphere, breath, signals propagating through air. The air here is so clear you can see 100 miles.
springs.feature: Balloon Fiesta Park — 500+ balloons fill the air every October

springs.name: healthSpring
springs.location: Hot Springs, Arkansas — Hot Springs National Park
springs.why_here: Hot Springs National Park is literally named after healing water. People have bathed here for 1000+ years for health. Bathhouse Row — 8 historic bathhouses. The water comes from 4000 years of rain percolating through the Ouachita Mountains, heated by the earth, emerging at 143°F. healthSpring IS healing springs.
springs.feature: Bathhouse Row — 47 springs producing 700K gallons/day of 143°F water

springs.name: neuralSpring
springs.location: Mountain View, California — Shoreline Amphitheatre area
springs.why_here: Silicon Valley IS the neural network of the world. Where AI was born, where neural networks were first trained at scale, where the compute infrastructure lives. neuralSpring does AI/neural networks. Silicon Valley does AI/neural networks. The spring IS the valley.
springs.feature: Silicon Valley — birthplace of modern AI, surrounded by mountains and ocean

springs.name: sourDough
springs.location: San Francisco, California — Boudin Bakery / Fisherman's Wharf
springs.why_here: San Francisco IS sourdough. The city's sourdough culture has been alive since 1849 (the Gold Rush). Boudin Bakery's starter is 175+ years old — the oldest continuously-operating sourdough in the Americas. The fog and cool air create unique lactobacilli. sourDough IS San Francisco sourdough.
springs.feature: Boudin Bakery — sourdough starter alive since 1849

springs.name: songBird
springs.location: New Orleans, Louisiana — French Quarter / Preservation Hall
springs.why_here: New Orleans IS song. Jazz was born here — the most complex mesh of improvised musical communication ever created. songBird does mesh networking. Jazz does mesh networking. Each musician listens to all others and responds in real-time. Polyphonic, decentralized, alive. The mesh IS the music.
springs.feature: Preservation Hall — jazz since 1961, no amplification, pure acoustic mesh

springs.name: sweetGrass
springs.location: Blackfeet Nation / Glacier National Park, Montana
springs.why_here: Sweetgrass (Hierochloe odorata) is sacred to the Blackfeet and many Indigenous nations. It's braided — THREE strands together, representing mind/body/spirit. sweetGrass does ATTRIBUTION — braiding W3C PROV-O strands. The braid IS the attribution chain. And Glacier National Park: pristine, preserved, ATTRIBUTED to the people who cared for it for 10,000+ years.
springs.feature: Sweetgrass braids — three strands, sacred medicine, attribution through ceremony

springs.name: rhizoCrypt
springs.fullName: The Root — Ephemeral DAG & Merkle Trees
springs.location: Seattle, Washington — Olympic Sculpture Park / Underground
springs.why_here: Seattle has the Underground — an entire hidden city beneath the streets, built after the Great Fire of 1889. The old city was buried and a new one built ON TOP. rhizoCrypt does ephemeral DAGs — root systems, underground networks. Seattle's Underground IS the ephemeral root system. And the Pacific Northwest has the largest mycelial networks on Earth.
springs.feature: Seattle Underground — buried city from 1889, root systems beneath the surface

springs.name: loamSpine
springs.why_here: The Grand Canyon IS the immutable ledger. 2 billion years of geological history visible in one cross-section. Each stratum is a BLOCK in the chain. Once deposited, it cannot be changed. loamSpine does immutable ledgers. The Grand Canyon IS an immutable ledger. Every layer is a commit that cannot be reverted.
springs.feature: 277 miles, 18 miles wide, 6000 ft deep — 2 billion years of immutable commits

springs.name: coralReef
springs.location: Key West, Florida — Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary
springs.why_here: The Florida Reef is the 3rd largest barrier reef in the world. Coral IS parallel computation — millions of polyps executing the same shader simultaneously. coralReef does GPU shader compilation. Coral reefs DO massively parallel computation. Each polyp = one GPU thread.
springs.feature: Florida Reef — 358 miles, 3rd largest barrier reef on Earth

springs.name: petalTongue
springs.why_here: General Sherman — the largest tree on Earth by volume. You can SEE it. It's VISUAL. petalTongue does scientific visualization — making the invisible VISIBLE. The sequoia makes the invisible (thousands of years of growth) VISIBLE in a single organism you can see and touch.
springs.feature: General Sherman Tree — 275 ft tall, 52,500 cubic ft, ~2200 years old

springs.name: toadStool
springs.why_here: Toadstool Geologic Park — actual toadstool-shaped rock formations (hoodoos). Literal toadStools in the earth. The park has 30-million-year-old fossils and the shapes look like mushroom caps on thin stalks. toadStool dispatches compute across GPU/NPU/CPU. The toadstool shape IS the dispatch — a thin stalk (bus) supporting a wide cap (compute surface).
springs.feature: Hoodoo formations — mushroom-shaped erosion pillars, 30M year old fossils

springs.name: skunkBat
springs.location: Carlsbad Caverns National Park, New Mexico
springs.why_here: 400,000 Brazilian free-tailed BATS emerge from Carlsbad every summer evening at dusk. They are the night defense — eating 3 tons of insects per night. skunkBat does network defense. The bats do network defense. They emerge from darkness, devour threats, return underground. The skunk is the smell that repels. The bat is the sonar that detects.
springs.feature: 400,000 bats emerging at dusk — largest visible animal aggregation in North America

springs.name: bearDog
springs.why_here: Kodiak bears guard salmon streams with their lives. The fjords are impenetrable — sheer ice walls on all sides. bearDog does cryptography — TLS, Ed25519, BLAKE3. Bears guard the perimeter. The fjords ARE the encryption — nobody gets through without going through the narrow, defended channel.
springs.feature: Harding Icefield — 700 sq miles of ice, bears at every river mouth

springs.name: nestGate
springs.why_here: nestGate is the front door. It IS the origin. Content-addressed storage = the filing cabinet in your own home. You don't travel to find it. It's RIGHT HERE.
springs.feature: The origin — where content is stored and addressed
